meta.logMessageLike: SELECT     target_ts                            AS time,     argMax(forecast_value, generated_at) AS forecast,     argMax(forecast_lower, generated_at) AS lower_p10,     argMax(forecast_upper, generated_at) AS upper_p90 FROM monitoring.vllm_forecasts WHERE forecast_metric = 'vllm:forecast_num_requests_running'   AND $__timeFilter(target_ts) GROUP BY target_ts ORDER BY target_ts

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    target_ts                            AS time,
    argMax(forecast_value, generated_at) AS req_forecast
FROM monitoring.vllm_forecasts
WHERE forecast_metric = 'vllm:forecast_num_requests_running'
  AND $__timeFilter(target_ts)
GROUP BY target_ts
ORDER BY target_ts
